description: This Java source file defines the `ConfigXMLReader` class, responsible for reading and parsing XML configuration files related to web application controllers in the OFBiz framework. It includes inner classes for managing controller configurations, request mappings, events, responses, and view mappings.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader
classes.description: Main class responsible for reading, parsing, and caching web application controller configurations from XML files. It includes methods for locating controller XML files, loading controllers, and facilitating request and view mappings.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.ControllerConfig
classes.description: Represents the controller configuration parsed from controller XML files, including handler mappings, request mappings, view mappings, and included configurations.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.Event
classes.description: Encapsulates event-related data such as type, path, invoke, transaction settings, and metrics for a controller's event.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.RequestMap
classes.description: Defines request mapping information, including URI, method, security, event, response mappings, and associated metrics.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.RequestResponse
classes.description: Represents a response configuration associated with a request, including type, value, status code, redirection parameters, and user messages.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.RequestResponseUserMessage
classes.description: Details of user messages in responses, including resource, value, and originating field.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.ViewMap
classes.description: Defines view mappings such as name, page, type, security attributes, caching, encoding, and description.

methods.name: getControllerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the ControllerConfig object for a given URL or WebappInfo, reading and parsing the controller XML if needed.

methods.name: findControllerFilesWithRequest
methods.description: Finds controller XML files that contain a specific request URI, optionally filtered by partial path, with results cached.

methods.name: findControllerRequestUniqueForTargetType
methods.description: Finds unique request identifiers for a given target and URL mode, linking them to controller files.

methods.name: loadDocument
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML document from a URL and returns the root element.
